compiled_state.title: [reconciler/inbound_differ]: ticket_type field synced Jira->local would corrupt epics into bugs
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

**Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior (CLI_user)
**code_version:** 832f212401169ae7a65cdaf45ec321384ddea2ce

### Expected
ticket_type is governed by an approved sync exception: outbound updates do NOT propagate local->Jira. The symmetric inbound direction should be equivalently excluded -- Jira's coarser type taxonomy (Bug/Story/Task/Epic) does not have a meaningful reverse-mapping for the richer local types that local users assign (e.g. 'epic' as a planning container that exists pre-binding).

### Actual
On a dry-run reconcile pass over the current fleet, the inbound differ emits 2 surviving ticket_type mutations that would overwrite local 'epic' with Jira 'bug':
- DIG-4346 -> 5d92-105c-a047-4d07: local='epic' -> jira='bug' (would apply)
- DIG-4473 -> 9679-695c-6e11-4d95: local='epic' -> jira='bug' (would apply)

These survive the PR #457 bidir suppression because the outbound differ does NOT emit ticket_type (correctly honoring the outbound exception) -- so there is no contradiction for the suppression contract to resolve. The inbound emission goes through and would silently demote local epics to bugs on the next live pass.

### Root cause (suspected)
The inbound differ's field-diff loop almost certainly compares ticket_type as a regular scalar field without an exclusion filter analogous to the outbound exception. Symmetric exclusion was missed when the outbound exception was approved.

### Production impact
Hard blocker for production cron enablement. If the reconciler runs against the fleet in live mode, at least 2 epics are immediately corrupted to bugs; the count grows with every future Jira-side ticket_type edit. Local 'epic' state is load-bearing for the preplanning / sprint skills, so this is a correctness regression not just a cosmetic.

### Suggested fix
In plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/inbound_differ.py::_diff_jira_vs_local, exclude ticket_type from inbound diffs. Mirror the outbound exception.

### Discovery context
Surfaced during the 5-batch CRU dry-run validation (50 bound tickets sampled, 0 phantom mutations in sample). The 3 surviving fleet-wide inbound mutations were inspected individually as part of the production-readiness gate. Two of the three are this bug.
